Quick Answer

How much does ChatGPT cost?

ChatGPT pricing spans six plans: Free at $0, Go at $8/month, Plus at $20/month, Pro at $100 or $200/month depending on usage tier, Business at $20/seat/month billed annually ($25 monthly, two-seat minimum), and Enterprise at custom pricing.

Paid tiers add the newest GPT-5.6 models, higher limits, and tools like Deep Research and Agent mode.

OpenAI now sells ChatGPT six different ways, and three of the tiers cost within a few dollars of each other per person.

Picking wrong is easy, and it happens in both directions: individuals paying $200 for usage they’d never hit, and teams handling client data on $20 Plus accounts that lack the one guarantee they legally need.

The plan cards don’t make the differences obvious.
